title: Abubatsi b'inkingi ndende
intro: Uhagaze imbere y'amatongo y'umujyi wa kera mwiza cyane, inkingi zawo ndende zaraguye. Umuyaga uhuha mu mihanda irimo ubusa, ujyana urwibutso rw'abantu b'intwari bahoze bategeka ibyo bihugu. Bari bande?
clues: Twari abantu bafite imbaraga n'ubuhanga bidasanzwe, bazwiho inyubako zacu zikomeye n'iterambere ryacu.
Twari dutuye mu gihugu cyuzuyemo imicanga n'imisozi y'amabuye, kandi twizeraga ko nta muntu n'umwe wadutsinda.
Intumwa yatugezeho iturutse mu muryango wacu, iduhamagarira gusenga Allah wenyine, ariko twaramwanze turamuseka.
Twirataga tuti 'Ni nde uturusha imbaraga?', maze dukomeza kwirata no gusenga ibigirwamana.
Allah yatwoherereje umuyaga mwinshi cyane wahushye amajoro arindwi n'iminsi umunani, urimbura byose.
Twari abantu ba 'Ad, abubatsi ba Iram, kandi iherezo ryacu ryabaye umuburo ku bazaza nyuma yabo bose.

location.label: Izina ry'umujyi wabo w'icyamamare ni irihe?

outcome.label: Ni iyihe iherezo ryabo rya nyuma?
options: Bararimbuwe kandi ibisigazwa byabo byabaye isomo
outcome.answer: Bararimbuwe kandi ibisigazwa byabo byabaye isomo

arabic: تُدَمِّرُ كُلَّ شَىْءٍۭ بِأَمْرِ رَبِّهَا فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ لَا يُرَىٰٓ إِلَّا مَسَـٰكِنُهُمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
verse: Destroying everything by command of its Lord. And they became so that nothing was seen [of them] except their dwellings. Thus do We recompense the criminal people. (46:25)
